player_prompt.intro:
A si Jokkondir {player_id} e Wild Tic Tac Toe.
E turna, a yaa wi'i woodi 'X' ko 'O' e bortu nguu.
A wondi e woodugo three e woodi nguu (X ko O) e row.
A yaa wondi e woodugo nguu.
Wodi woyla using hebla '[X 4]' ina woodi X e bortu majje.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Woyla baasi ko hebla. Wonaa '[X 4]' ko '[O 2]' hebla.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Limgal limre je wala kuugal: {cell}. Gotta be hakkude 0 e 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Jaɓɓorgo Caka. Ɗo'ol {cell} ɗon naama je mari yimɓe feere.

game_action.placed: Jokkondir {player_id} ina woodi almari ({mark}) e cell {cell}
